complaints.title: Clogged Stormwater Drain on 2nd Cross Street
complaints.description: Severe waterlogging due to blocked culvert near corner shop.
complaints.councillor_notes: Field inspection done at 2nd Cross Street. Identified blocked culvert and high water stagnation. Escalated to Engineering/Drainage department for emergency desilting.

complaints.title: Broken Streetlight on 4th Main Road
complaints.description: The streetlight near pillar 42 has been flickering and completely turned off for the past two days, causing safety concerns for night commuters.
complaints.councillor_notes: Inspected on 4th Main Road personally. Pillar 42 wiring is damaged, requires urgent intervention by Electrical Department.

complaints.title: Severe garbage dumping and waste overflow opposite Millerpuram School
complaints.description: Commercial vegetable crates and decomposing municipal solid waste have been dumped openly along the school perimeter road for over 5 days. Cattle and stray animals are scattering garbage onto the carriageway, blocking pedestrian movement.
complaints.landmark: Opposite St. Thomas Higher Secondary School Gate
complaints.councillor_notes: Inspected site with ward sanitary inspector. Confirmed heavy overflow and endorsed immediate JCB clearance.

complaints.title: Underground drinking water main line burst at Bryant Nagar 3rd Street
complaints.description: Treated municipal drinking water is spewing continuously from a burst underground pipeline joint, flooding the street and causing acute drinking water pressure drops in neighbouring residential blocks.
complaints.address_text: Bryant Nagar 3rd Street West, Ward 43, Thoothukudi
complaints.councillor_notes: Inspected water pipe rupture on ground; verified and forwarded to TWAD / Water Supply Department for emergency repair.

complaints.title: Hazardous open manhole without warning barricade near Palayamkottai Bus Terminal
complaints.description: Heavy commercial bus vibrations broke the concrete slab of a stormwater catch basin. The deep opening poses an immediate fatal hazard to two-wheelers and pedestrians, especially after sunset.
complaints.landmark: 50m from Palayamkottai Main Bus Stand Entry

complaints.title: Deep craters and broken bitumen on Tenkasi Temple Street causing vehicle damage
complaints.description: Monsoon runoff created deep 2-foot trenches in the main road connecting Old Bus Stand to Kasi Viswanathar Temple. Several school buses and autos are getting stuck daily.
complaints.landmark: Near Kasi Viswanathar Temple North Arch

complaints.title: Broken LED streetlight pole leaning precariously after localized storm
complaints.description: Streetlight pole fixture #ST-45-12 was struck by a falling palm branch. It is dark at night, creating safety issues for fishermen returning home late.

Sanitary team with bobcat loader deployed for complete site clearance.
Emergency valve isolated to stop wastage; welding team dispatched with 150mm ductile iron sleeve.
Excavation completed and replacement pipe joint installation underway.
Pipeline successfully sleeved, pressure tested up to 3.5 bar, and asphalt patch backfilled.
Hydraulic bucket truck dispatched for replacement LED fitting installation.
70W LED fixture replaced and tested; citizen confirmed night illumination is restored.
Grievance officially submitted with location and description

complaint_resolution_evidence.description: 150mm ductile iron pipe joint replaced with high-grade flanged collar. Clean pressure reading verified at 3.5 bar without leaks. Trench compacted with wet gravel mix.

complaint_resolution_evidence.description: Old rusted bracket dismantled and new Philips 70W warm-white LED luminaire mounted and wired to timer circuit.

complaint_comments.comment_text: The stench is reaching inside classrooms during afternoon hours. Please expedite cleaning before Monday.

Water supply to odd-numbered houses on 3rd street was disrupted since yesterday morning.
Pipeline isolated at Valve #4. Main pressure restoration anticipated by 4:00 PM today.

complaint_escalations.detailed_reason: Critical open manhole hazard remained completely unaddressed past the 5-day deadline. School children pass this route daily.
complaint_escalations.official_action_notes: Referred to Superintending Engineer for immediate spot barricading and cast iron grating placement.

confidential_accountability_reports.description: Public grievance for open stormwater catch basin was marked as completed in the internal register despite open pit continuing to endanger evening traffic without barricade.

accountability_case_history.findings_or_notes: Confidential report submitted with time-stamped geotagged photograph showing unaddressed hazard.

Preliminary review indicates contractor submitted closure without field inspection photo. Notice served to Tirunelveli Engineering Cell.

departments.name: Solid Waste Management & Sanitation Department
departments.name_ta: தூய்மைப் பணி மற்றும் திடக்கழிவு மேலாண்மைத் துறை
departments.description: Responsible for municipal solid waste collection, roadside clearance, garbage bin sanitization, and processing facilities.
departments.description_ta: நகராட்சி திடக்கழிவு மேலாண்மை, தெருக்கள் தூய்மைப் பணி, குப்பைத் தொட்டிகள் மற்றும் கழிவு அகற்றுதல் ஆகியவற்றுக்கு பொறுப்பான துறை.
departments.head_officer: Thiru S. Balakrishnan (Chief Municipal Health Officer)

departments.name: Highways & Municipal Roads Department
departments.description: Responsible for arterial road paving, pothole repairs, bitumen overlay, paver block relaying, and storm drainage culvert integrity.
departments.description_ta: தார்ப்பாய் சாலைகள், பள்ளங்கள் சீரமைத்தல், பேவர் பிளாக் அமைத்தல் மற்றும் சாலைப் பராமரிப்புப் பணிகள்.

departments.name: TANGEDCO / Municipal Street Lighting Wing
departments.description: Responsible for public streetlights, LED fixtures, timer circuits, sagging high-tension electrical cables, distribution poles, and transformer safety.
departments.description_ta: தெருவிளக்குகள் பழுதுபார்ப்பு, புதிய எல்.இ.டி விளக்குகள், மின் கம்பங்கள் மற்றும் மின்சார பாதுகாப்பு.

departments.name: Stormwater Drainage & Flood Mitigation Wing
departments.name_ta: மழைநீர் வடிகால் மற்றும் வெள்ளத் தடுப்புப் பிரிவு
departments.description: Responsible for construction, desilting, repair, and flood channel clearance of all roadside concrete and underground stormwater drains.
departments.description_ta: மழைநீர் வடிகால்கள் தூர்வாருதல், சீரமைத்தல் மற்றும் வெள்ள நீர் தேங்குவதைத் தடுத்தல்.
departments.head_officer: Er. K. Sivaraman (Executive Engineer, Storm Drains)

departments.name: Underground Sewerage & Sanitation Board (TWAD/CMWSSB)
departments.name_ta: பாதாள சாக்கடை மற்றும் கழிவுநீர் மேலாண்மை வாரியம்
departments.description: Responsible for underground sewer networks, heavy-duty manhole covers, sewer pumping stations, and clearing hazardous blockages.
departments.description_ta: பாதாள சாக்கடை அடைப்புகள், கழிவுநீர் வெளியேற்றம் மற்றும் மேன்ஹோல் மூடிகள் பாதுகாப்பு.

departments.name: Municipal Drinking Water Supply Department
departments.name_ta: நகராட்சி குடிநீர் வழங்கல் மற்றும் விநியோகத் துறை
departments.description: Responsible for treated drinking water transmission mains, distribution feeder pipes, street public taps, pressure balancing, and water quality testing.
departments.description_ta: குடிநீர் விநியோகம், குழாய் உடைப்பு சீரமைப்பு, நீர் அழுத்தம் மற்றும் குடிநீர் தூய்மை உறுதி செய்தல்.
departments.head_officer: Er. K. Murugan (Asst. Executive Engineer, Water Works)

departments.name: Public Infrastructure, Parks & Buildings Department
departments.name_ta: பொதுக் கட்டமைப்பு, பூங்காக்கள் மற்றும் கட்டடங்கள் துறை
departments.description: Responsible for municipal bus shelters, public parks, children play equipment, community halls, public amenities, and street structures.
departments.description_ta: பேருந்து நிழற்குடைகள், பூங்காக்கள், பொதுக் கழிப்பறைகள் மற்றும் நகராட்சி சொத்துக்கள் பராமரிப்பு.

departments.name: Traffic, Road Safety & Enforcement Cell
departments.description: Responsible for clearing unauthorized construction encroachments, road debris, directional signages, speed calming measures, and safety barricades.
departments.description_ta: சாலை ஆக்கிரமிப்புகள் அகற்றுதல், வேகத்தடைகள், போக்குவரத்து பலகைகள் மற்றும் சாலை பாதுகாப்பு.

departments.name: Public Health & Vector Control Department
departments.name_ta: பொது சுகாதாரம் மற்றும் கொசு ஒழிப்புத் துறை
departments.description: Responsible for thermal fogging, vector-borne disease prevention, anti-larval spray operations, stray animal control, and public health sanitation.
departments.description_ta: கொசு ஒழிப்புப் புகை மருந்து அடித்தல், டெங்கு தடுப்பு நடவடிக்கைகள் மற்றும் பொது சுகாதாரம்.

departments.name: Revenue, Grievance & General Civic Administration
departments.name_ta: வருவாய் மற்றும் பொது மக்கள் குறைதீர்ப்புப் பிரிவு
departments.description: Responsible for general civic petitions, property tax disputes, trade licenses, public nuisance complaints, and inter-departmental grievance redressal.
departments.description_ta: பொது மக்கள் மனுக்கள், நகராட்சி குறைதீர்ப்பு மற்றும் பொது நிர்வாகப் பணிகள்.
